fingerprints.commitMessage:
feat: implement resilient SARIF 2.1.0 processing pipeline and scanner coordinator (Steps 1-7)

- Added official OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 schema and Draft-04 validator (validator.ts)
- Refactored monolithic sarif.ts into modular pipeline (parser, findings, merger, validator)
- Added atomic SARIF report publication with pre-write schema validation
- Implemented robust scanner execution in tools.ts (timeouts, process kill, stale report cleanup, diagnostics)
- Integrated concurrent scan coordinator in scan.ts with error isolation, failure handling, and custom output path support
- Handled empty and custom report paths safely across interactive and non-interactive CLI modes
- Configured report directories and gitignore policies for results
- Added comprehensive unit tests (85 tests passing across 12 test files)
